title: Collaborate GitHub Agent Registry
description: Repository-controlled mapping of GitHub accounts and branch namespaces to collaboration agent IDs and runtime tools.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema from .github/agent-registry.json.

schema_version.description: Registry data format version. Increment only when introducing a deliberately incompatible shape.

agents.description: Repository-controlled agent entries. Cross-entry uniqueness, prefix-overlap, and identity-matching rules are enforced by the Go validator.

agent_id.description: Stable, lowercase internal ID; do not derive it from a mutable GitHub login.

status.description: Only active entries can identify pull-request authors or authorize runtime tools. Unconfigured entries reserve names/prefixes but have no GitHub identity and deny all tools.

github_identities.description: GitHub account identities accepted for this agent. Matching uses account_type and immutable github_user_id; login is human-readable.

branch_prefixes.description: Optional branch namespaces ending in '/', used to disambiguate platforms sharing a GitHub account. Prefixes are reserved even while an entry is unconfigured or suspended.

allowed_tools.description: Explicit runtime allowlist. Supported namespaces are mcp:<tool_name> and adapter:<provider_name>. Empty means deny all.

login.description: Current GitHub login, compared case-insensitively for diagnostics; not the stable identity key.

github_user_id.description: Numeric GitHub user ID from the PR author's user object. Never substitute an App installation ID.

branchPrefix.description: Git branch-name prefix including the trailing slash. Matching is case-sensitive; completed refs are validated with Git's ref rules.
